nasa_datasets.name: NASA POWER daily weather
nasa_datasets.tells_you: Daily heat, cold, rain and the reference crop water demand (ETo) for your area.

nasa_datasets.name: GPM IMERG rainfall
nasa_datasets.tells_you: How much rain fell on your field each day, from NASA's satellite rain estimate.
nasa_datasets.note: Final run (gauge-adjusted) to its last day, Late run (satellite only) after that.

nasa_datasets.name: SMAP soil moisture (L4, root zone)
nasa_datasets.tells_you: How wet the soil is down to about 1 m compared with normal for this time of year.

nasa_datasets.name: SMAP soil moisture (L3, surface retrievals)
nasa_datasets.tells_you: The satellite's direct measurement of the top 5 cm of soil, on days it is reliable.
nasa_datasets.note: Retrievals over flooded rice or open water are flagged and dropped, not filled.

nasa_datasets.name: GRACE-FO groundwater
nasa_datasets.tells_you: Whether groundwater under your area is higher or lower than usual (percentile).
nasa_datasets.note: Model that assimilates GRACE/GRACE-FO gravity data; 2-3 month latency.

nasa_datasets.name: MODIS vegetation greenness (NDVI)
nasa_datasets.tells_you: How green the area is compared with the same two weeks in 2000-2025.

nasa_datasets.name: ECOSTRESS crop stress and water use
nasa_datasets.tells_you: Whether the crop is using as much water as it could (stress index) on days the space station passes over.

nasa_datasets.name: OPERA surface water (DSWx)
nasa_datasets.tells_you: When and how much of the field was under water (winter flooding, floods).

nasa_datasets.name: HLS (Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2)
nasa_datasets.tells_you: What is growing on the field and when it is bare, green or flooded, every 2-3 days.

nasa_datasets.name: Landsat 8/9 (NASA/USGS)
nasa_datasets.tells_you: Field greenness record used with Sentinel-2 in the main calendar.

nasa_datasets.name: NASADEM elevation
nasa_datasets.tells_you: Slope and low spots on and around the field.
nasa_datasets.note: Radar noise of 2-4 m on flat fields: slope uses a 150 m smoothed surface.

nasa_datasets.name: ISS astronaut photographs
nasa_datasets.tells_you: Photos of the area taken by astronauts on the International Space Station.
nasa_datasets.note: Image courtesy of the Earth Science and Remote Sensing Unit, NASA Johnson Space Center. Near the field, not of it.

observed_cover.detector: rule_ndvi consensus (backend/field calendar.json, calendar years whose CDL crop is the baseline crop; bare gaps <= 10 days merged)
